configuration.sample_source: First 100 rows of the existing paired Gaussian sample bank, first 200 observations per row
configuration.brent_objective: Derivative-free analytic Gaussian Q_0; scan grid, refine each strict valley and compare endpoints
configuration.timing: One fresh call per method and sample, 100 timed calls per method; mean across all 100. Method order randomized separately for each sample. All methods initialized once before timing. The grid scan and every valley refinement are included. No sample-specific matrix or objective cache is shared between timed calls.
